description.value: Shorewater Resort is a self-contained, condo-style beachfront resort in Qualicum Beach, perched directly on a natural sandy and pebble beach overlooking the Strait of Georgia and the coastal mountains. Guests stay in individually owned, fully equipped suites ranging from garden-view units to oceanfront chalets, all with private patios and full kitchens. As of October 2024 the resort operates without on-site office staff, using keyless entry managed remotely by True Key Vacations.

address.value: 3295 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, B.C. V9K 2C6
